authority_audit.m2138_authorized_budget: one license query, one VCS compile, two serial simv runs, two SAIF files, zero DC/PTPX, no retry

evidence: The RTL explicitly resets every row_live_q, cache_valid_q, and slot_valid_q element; the testbench applies five reset clocks and then performs the complete 383-cycle descriptor preload.
The ordinary fixed workload completes the exact 20,292-cycle, 14,304-read functional ledger with public and valid-qualified payload knownness checks and no functional fatal.

All 223 nonzero-TX records are confined to five unpacked-array/internal-validity families. Stateful arrays show the exact all-indices-except-current-index shape, and every TX duration is a finite prefix that ends on a later element update.

The UCLI chooses the DUT scope, runs through reset and preload to the first stop, and only then executes power -enable. Therefore the activity observer did not witness the reset/preload transitions that established the current unpacked-array states.
The SAIF duration, activity-record count, and every T0+T1+TX conservation equation are already exact, excluding the prior mixed-edge window failure and excluding a parser arithmetic failure.
root_cause.residual_uncertainty: M2125 checks public controls and valid-qualified payloads, not the five internal TX families at the first boundary. Thus the current artifact does not by itself formally distinguish native-SAIF late sampling from a validity-masked internal X; it strongly favors the former but cannot support a power claim until the acquisition protocol is rerun under a fresh identity.

source_review_gap.m2138_delta_scope: option-aware SDF/UNIT_DELAY path guard only; it inherited the M2125 activity protocol unchanged
source_review_gap.consequence: The source hammers proved that the parser rejects TX and that the UCLI text had the intended two-stop form; they did not prove that late native-SAIF enable samples the existing state of SystemVerilog unpacked arrays.

only_allowed_successor.scope: fresh additive ordinary-axis native-SAIF acquisition preflight, independently source-hammered before one execution
minimum_protocol: Keep the exact M2018/M803 RTL, M2051 fixture, slot-42 workload, 3-ns clock, exact cycle/read/product/commit ledgers, parser gates, and no-retry discipline.

Establish the DUT activity scope and execute power -enable before the first run, so the monitor observes reset and the 383-cycle preload. At the first settled-negedge stop, execute power -reset to zero the activity counters while retaining observed state; then run the exact execution window, disable, and report.
Do not rely on power -reset while monitoring has never been enabled; the preflight must test the enable-before-reset/preload sequence first.

Add a first-boundary knownness census for every row_live_q, cache_valid_q, slot_valid_q, bridge_overflow, and rsp_shape_legal element in the selected DUT. This is diagnostic evidence only and must not force, deposit, mask, or initialize DUT state.
Require duration 60,876 ns, 93,971 records, TX=0 for every record, exact conservation, exact functional ledger, and nonzero critical activity.
forbidden_repairs: dropping MDA/SV/internal records from the activity scope
changing RTL reset semantics solely to sanitize SAIF
running both axes or DC/PTPX before the ordinary acquisition preflight is independently admitted
only_allowed_successor.after_preflight_pass_only: A separately identified two-axis source-RTL activity campaign may be authored and independently reviewed; mapped saif_map/PTPX remains another fresh gate.
